subject: Post-demo: Hosted quickstart, rate expectations & next owners
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Morales <alex.morales@finlytics.ai>, Priya Singh <priya@finlytics.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 13:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: Hosted quickstart, rate expectations & next owners

Hi Alex / Priya,

Thanks again for joining the demo this morning — really appreciate the thoughtful questions. I wanted to capture a short recap and a few clarifying items so our teams can line up the right evaluation plan.

Quick recap:
- You’re leaning toward trying Redwood Hosted for the initial pilot to move fast, but will need a path to Dedicated or Private if throughput or data residency requirements tighten.
- Primary workload: user-facing summarization and long-form Q&A across customer documents. Token sizes average ~600 tokens/request.
- Compliance: SOC 2 + basic audit log needs called out during procurement.

Clarifying questions for sizing and next steps:
1) Traffic profile: can you confirm expected steady-state RPS and peak bursts (per endpoint)? We heard ~40–50rps average in the call but want precise targets for ratecap planning.
2) Latency SLOs: is 300ms p95 across the user flow acceptable, or do you need tighter SLAs for certain endpoints?
3) Data residency: will all data remain in the US, or do you have EU/APAC residency needs for this pilot?
4) Endpoint mapping: how many distinct endpoints (chat/summarize/embeddings) do you expect to exercise in sandbox?
5) Procurement: is there an early PO or SOW cadence we should align to, and who owns procurement on your side?

What we propose next (initial Hosted quickstart):
- Provision 3 sandbox endpoints on Hosted (1 chat, 1 summarization, 1 embeddings) with a 50rps ceiling each for the first two weeks.
- Enable KV/prefix caching suggestions for summaries to reduce token cost and latency.
- Provide SOC 2 artifacts and a short ops playbook for your security team.

Attached: redwood_quickstart_checklist.pdf (one-pager with items we’ll provision).

If you can reply with the answers to the bullets above, Ben (cc’d) and Karthik will propose a short technical kickoff window and we’ll lock in the sandbox endpoints.

Thanks,

Monica Patel
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0136

---
Attachment: redwood_quickstart_checklist.pdf (one-pager)
From: Alex Morales <alex.morales@finlytics.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Priya Singh <priya@finlytics.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 16:24:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Hosted quickstart, rate expectations & next owners

Thanks Monica — quick answers below. Great demo.

Traffic & sizing: steady-state ~45 rps across our primary summarize endpoint, peaks up to ~120 rps during batch imports (10–15 minute spikes). Embeddings requests will be lower (~10–15 rps).
Latency: 300ms p95 is our target for the UI flows; background batch jobs can tolerate up to 1s.
Data residency: for this pilot all data will be US-based. If we move to EU customers later we’ll revisit Private/VPC needs.
Endpoints: plan to use 1 summarization, 1 chat, 1 embeddings endpoint in sandbox. Possibly a separate reranker later.
Procurement: procurement lead is Priya Singh (cc’d). We typically do a 30-day pilot PO; I’ll coordinate internal approval — likely signed by the end of next week.

Also: can you confirm whether Hosted sandbox supports streaming responses for chat endpoints? That impacts our UI prototype.

—Alex
Alex Morales
Head of Platform Integrations, Finlytics
alex.morales@finlytics.ai
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Morales <alex.morales@finlytics.ai>, Priya Singh <priya@finlytics.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 18:01:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Hosted quickstart, rate expectations & next owners

Appreciate the details, Alex — that profile is very helpful. A few technical notes and a recommended sandbox mapping: 

- Streaming: yes, Hosted sandbox supports streaming responses for chat endpoints (HTTP chunked + SDK streaming) — we’ll enable it for your chat endpoint.
- Suggested sandbox footprint (initial):
  * summarize-sbx -> 50 rps cap, model variant small-medium, KV prefix caching enabled
  * chat-sbx -> 50 rps cap, streaming enabled, 512 token kv-window
  * embed-sbx -> 20 rps cap, batched 8 requests per call for cost efficiency

- For the peak bursts (~120 rps), we recommend configuring a short-term burst policy (auto-burst to Dedicated pool) or a higher-rate canary for the batch-import window. We can simulate your import cadence and advise on an autoscale threshold.
- Compliance: we’ll package the SOC 2 summary and audit-friendly logging export; the latter includes token-level usage breakdown (redacted payloads available on request).

I attached a quick sandbox_endpoint_matrix.csv to show proposed route names, caps, and caching toggles. If the cap numbers look reasonable we’ll provision the sandbox endpoints tomorrow and share credentials.

Next steps I’ll own: provision sandbox endpoints, share streaming example code, run a short load test (script + results) during your next window. Proposed tech kickoff: Wed 11/25 at 10am PT — does that work?

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
---
Attachment: sandbox_endpoint_matrix.csv
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Morales <alex.morales@finlytics.ai>, Priya Singh <priya@finlytics.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Hosted quickstart, rate expectations & next owners

Perfect — thanks Alex and Ben. Summary of next actions and owners: 

- Ben: provision the three sandbox endpoints (summarize-sbx, chat-sbx, embed-sbx), enable streaming on chat, share credentials and streaming example by EOD Tue. (owner: Ben Carter)
- Alex / Priya: confirm PO timing (target end-of-week) and share any procurement form or SSO requirements. (owner: Finlytics)
- Monica: coordinate SOC 2 artifacts and send a short ops playbook; I'll open a HubSpot deal and attach the artifacts. (owner: Monica Patel)
- Karthik: stand by for the technical kickoff to advise on autoscaling rules and Dedicated fallback options if bursts exceed threshold. (owner: Karthik Iyer)

Tentative tech kickoff: Wed 11/25 10:00am PT — if that works I’ll send a calendar invite with an agenda (endpoint mapping, load profile, success criteria).

If you prefer to start with lower caps and iterate, say the word — we can start at 30 rps per route and raise after the first week based on observed token cost and latency.

Thanks again — looking forward to the pilot.

-Monica
